parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

*   **zh** (default): Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The UID of the member in Cloud Firewall.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw describe-vpc-zone --lang zh --member-uid 1415189284827022 --region-no cn-shanghai --environment VPC --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw DescribeVpcZone --region cn-hangzhou --RegionNo 'cn-shanghai' --MemberUid 1415189284827022 --Environment VPC --Lang zh
